dialogue.content: おはようございます。本日はよろしくお願いいたします。時間になったら始めさせていただきますね。
dialogue.English: Good morning. Thank you for being here today. We'll get started at the scheduled time.

dialogue.content: よろしくお願いします
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: こんにちは、相談員です。本日はよくお越しくださいました。
dialogue.English: Hello, I'm the counselor. Thank you very much for coming in today.

dialogue.content: 初めに年齢と性別、相談内容を教えてくださいね。
dialogue.English: To start, could you please tell me your age, gender, and what you'd like to talk about?

dialogue.content: 60歳　女性息子についての悩みですよろしくお願いします
dialogue.English: I'm a 60-year-old woman. I'm worried about my son. Thank you for your help.

dialogue.content: はい、息子さんのことについてですね。お話しやすところからでいいので、詳しく教えていただけますか？
dialogue.English: I see, it's about your son. Please, feel free to start wherever you're most comfortable and tell me more.

dialogue.content: はい、30代の息子がいます急に仕事を辞めてプロゴルファーになると言い出したのです今は寮に入っているのですが結婚もしていなくてこれからがすごい不安で
dialogue.English: Yes, I have a son in his 30s. He suddenly quit his job and announced that he's going to become a professional golfer. He's living in a dormitory now, but he isn't married, and I'm incredibly anxious about his future.

dialogue.content: 応援したい気持ちはあるけどどうしても心配や不安の方が大きくて、、、
dialogue.English: I want to support him, but my feelings of worry and anxiety are just overwhelming...

dialogue.content: なんと、プロゴルファーに。唐突なお話でさぞ驚かれましたよね。
dialogue.English: Wow, a professional golfer. That must have come as quite a shock to you.

dialogue.content: とても驚きました、、
dialogue.English: I was very surprised...

dialogue.content: ええ、不安になるのも無理もないと思います。
dialogue.English: Yes, it's perfectly understandable that you would feel anxious.

dialogue.content: それでも応援したいお気持ちもあるのですね・・・。とても複雑なお気持ちのようですね。
dialogue.English: And yet, you also have a desire to support him... It sounds like you have very complex feelings.

dialogue.content: そうですね
dialogue.English: That's right.

dialogue.content: 今、息子さんはもう会社を辞められている状態なのですか？
dialogue.English: So, has your son already quit his job?

dialogue.content: はい辞める報告をした。と聞いた時もかなり驚きました
dialogue.English: Yes, when he told me that he had already given his notice, I was quite shocked.

dialogue.content: そうだったんですね。もしかして何の前触れもない急な報告だったのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: I see. Was it a sudden announcement with no warning at all?

dialogue.content: そうですね決めたからみたいな報告でした
dialogue.English: Yes, it was more like, 'I've decided,' and that was it.

dialogue.content: でも否定もできずそうなんだとしかいえなかったです
dialogue.English: But I couldn't bring myself to object, so all I could say was, "I see."

dialogue.content: そうでしたか。ええ、ええ、急に言われると、言葉も出なかったりしますよね。
dialogue.English: I understand. Yes, yes, when you are told something so suddenly, it can leave you at a loss for words.

dialogue.content: そうですね
dialogue.English: That's true.

dialogue.content: これからのことにもご不安を抱えているようですが、どういったところでそう感じていらっやるのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: You mentioned you're anxious about his future. Could you tell me more about what specifically is worrying you?

dialogue.content: この歳で仕事辞めて、もし、プロなんてなれないと現実と向き合った時に新たに職につくことができるのかであったり今は給料が本当に僅かなのでお金は大丈夫なのか、これから生活していけるのかだったり長男なので結婚できるか不安だったりですね…
dialogue.English: Quitting his job at this age, what if he can't make it as a pro and has to face reality? Will he be able to find a new job? His income is so little right now, so I worry if he'll be okay financially, if he can make a living. And since he's my eldest son, I worry if he'll ever get married...

dialogue.content: はい、どれも大事なことですよね。本当に息子さんのことを案じていらっしゃるんですね。
dialogue.English: Yes, those are all very important concerns. You're truly worried about your son.

dialogue.content: 案じて…
dialogue.English: Worried...

dialogue.content: そうですね
dialogue.English: Yes, I suppose so.

dialogue.content: もういい大人なので心配はいらないとはわかっているんですけどね
dialogue.English: I know he's a grown adult and I shouldn't have to worry, but...

dialogue.content: ええ、それでも心配してしまうのが親心というものですよね。それくらい大切に想っていいらっしゃるということだと思います。
dialogue.English: Yes, but it's a parent's nature to worry. I think it just shows how much you care about him.

dialogue.content: そうですね
dialogue.English: I suppose so.

dialogue.content: いま、とてもご不安なお気持ちのようですが、このことは、どなたかにご相談はされたのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: It sounds like you're feeling very anxious right now. Have you spoken to anyone else about this?

dialogue.content: 娘にはよく話します
dialogue.English: I talk to my daughter about it often.

dialogue.content: そうでしたか。娘さんとはどのようなことをお話しされたのですか？
dialogue.English: I see. What kinds of things have you discussed with your daughter?

dialogue.content: どうしても不安に思っちゃうってことだったり今どんなことしてるんだろうね？と話したり
dialogue.English: Things like how I can't help but feel anxious, or we'll wonder what he's up to now.

dialogue.content: ええ、そのようなことをお話しされたのですね。
dialogue.English: I see, so you've talked about things like that.

dialogue.content: お二人で息子さんのことを気にかけていらっしゃったのですね。
dialogue.English: It sounds like you're both concerned about your son.

dialogue.content: それでも、応援したいというのはどういった思いからだったのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: You also mentioned you want to support him. Could you tell me more about where that feeling comes from?

dialogue.content: 娘は結構楽観的なのでやりたいなら後悔しないようにやった方がいいよ！とか踏み出した勇気すごいね！とか大人なんだからちゃんと考えてるよ！など、そういうことを話すので、その時は、たしかに、信じて応援しないと！って思うんですよね
dialogue.English: My daughter is quite optimistic. She says things like, 'If it's what he wants to do, he should go for it so he has no regrets!' or 'It's amazing he had the courage to take that step!' and 'He's an adult, I'm sure he's thought it through!' When she says that, I do think, 'Yes, that's true, I have to believe in him and support him!'

dialogue.content: でも、1人でぐるぐる考えてるとやっばり不安だなぁって、、
dialogue.English: But when I'm alone and my thoughts are just spinning, I end up feeling anxious again...

dialogue.content: ええ、そうだったんですね。そういう意見を聞くと、せっかくだから応援したい気持ちもわいてきますよね。それでもどうしても不安なお気持ちもあるのですよね。
dialogue.English: Yes, I understand. Hearing that perspective makes you feel like you want to support his endeavor. And yet, the feeling of anxiety is still there.

dialogue.content: なんとも言えない感情ですね
dialogue.English: It's a feeling I can't quite describe.

dialogue.content: ええ、複雑なんですよね・・・。でも大切な存在だからこそ信じたいし、心配で不安。両方の気持ちを持っていて、当然だと思います。
dialogue.English: Yes, it's very complex... But it's because he's so important to you that you want to believe in him, and at the same time, you're worried and anxious. It's completely natural to have both of those feelings.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: この気持ちの板挟みで、今とても苦しくなっているのかもしれないですね。
dialogue.English: Perhaps you're feeling so distressed right now because you're torn between these two feelings.

dialogue.content: このモヤモヤする感情をスッキリさせたいですね、、
dialogue.English: I'd like to clear up this hazy, unsettled feeling...

dialogue.content: ええ、このままではしんどいですものね。
dialogue.English: Yes, it must be difficult to continue feeling this way.

dialogue.content: はい、、
dialogue.English: Yes...

dialogue.content: どうしたらいいのでしょうか
dialogue.English: What should I do?

dialogue.content: 息子さんからの急な報告に驚かれ、これからのことを心配している。それとは逆にもう大人だからと息子さんを信じ応援したい気持ちもあるのですよね。
dialogue.English: You were surprised by your son's sudden announcement and you're worried about his future. On the other hand, you also feel that because he's an adult, you should trust and support him.

dialogue.content: そうですね
dialogue.English: That's right.

dialogue.content: 心配になる理由として
dialogue.English: As for why I'm worried,

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: Yes?

dialogue.content: 息子がたまに帰ってくるのですがなんだかいつも機嫌がわるくて近況も聞ける感じではないのでそういうところを見てても心配になっています
dialogue.English: My son comes home occasionally, but he always seems to be in a bad mood, and it doesn't feel like I can ask how he's doing. Seeing him like that also makes me worry.

dialogue.content: しっかり話し合えたらもう少し安心すると思うのですが
dialogue.English: If we could have a proper talk, I think I would feel a little more at ease.

dialogue.content: なるほどですね。そういった様子を見ると、応援したい気持ちがあっても不安になってしまいますよね。
dialogue.English: I see. When you see him like that, it's understandable that you'd feel anxious, even if you want to support him.

dialogue.content: そうですね、、
dialogue.English: Yes...

dialogue.content: でも、大変そうな時期だからこそ何も言わずに応援してあげるべきなのかもしれないですし、、
dialogue.English: But, perhaps because it seems like a difficult time for him, maybe I should just support him without saying anything...

dialogue.content: この感情をどうしたらいいのか、、
dialogue.English: I am not sure what to do with these feelings...

dialogue.content: はい、それも大事になってくるのかもしれないですね。
dialogue.English: Yes, that might be an important part of it.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 見守るということは何もしていないようで、それも立派な行動になってきますので。
dialogue.English: Watching over someone might feel like you're not doing anything, but it is a valuable form of action in itself.

dialogue.content: 歯がゆいですね、、
dialogue.English: It's so frustrating...

dialogue.content: ええ、そうですよね・・・。
dialogue.English: Yes, I can imagine it is...

dialogue.content: これまでお話を聞かせていただいて、息子さんの心配をしながらもやはり応援したい気持ちの方が強いと感じたのですが、いかがでしょうか？
dialogue.English: From what you've told me so far, while you are worried about your son, I sense that your desire to support him is stronger. Does that sound right to you?

dialogue.content: そうですね応援したいけど、不安や心配って感じですね
dialogue.English: Yes, it's like I want to support him, but I'm also anxious and worried.

dialogue.content: はい、それと同時に心配はしても何もできない自分に歯がゆさを感じているのかなとも思いました。
dialogue.English: Yes, and at the same time, I thought that perhaps you feel frustrated with yourself for not being able to do anything besides worry.

dialogue.content: いかがでしょうか？
dialogue.English: How does that sound to you?

dialogue.content: たしかに、何かしてあげたいという気持ちが結構あったからこそなのかもしれないですね
dialogue.English: Indeed, perhaps it's precisely because I had a strong desire to do something for him.

dialogue.content: ええ、大切に想われているからこそ、余計にだったのかもしれないですね。
dialogue.English: Yes, precisely because you care for him so deeply, that feeling may be even stronger.

dialogue.content: そうですね
dialogue.English: I think so.

dialogue.content: なのでたまに息子さんが返ってきたときなど、何かできることもあるのではないかと思うのです。
dialogue.English: So, I think there might be something you can do, for example, when your son occasionally comes home.

dialogue.content: なるほど何でしょうか
dialogue.English: I see. Like what?

dialogue.content: 美味しいご飯作ったり
dialogue.English: Cooking a nice meal,

dialogue.content: お風呂沸かしておいたり
dialogue.English: Having a hot bath ready,

dialogue.content: とかでしょうか、、？
dialogue.English: Things like that...?

dialogue.content: ええ、いいですね！
dialogue.English: Yes, that sounds wonderful!

dialogue.content: きっと息子さん自身も大きなプレッシャーを抱えていると思うのです。
dialogue.English: I'm sure your son is under a great deal of pressure himself.

dialogue.content: そうですね今は見守る時期なのかもしれないですね
dialogue.English: You're right. Perhaps now is the time to just watch over him.

dialogue.content: ええ、そうですね。前向きに進んでいながらもしんどい中、たまに家に帰った時にそういう風に家がほっときを抜ける場所であることってとても大事なことだと思います。
dialogue.English: Yes, that's right. He's moving forward, but it's also a struggle. For him to have a home to come back to sometimes, a place where he can relax and let his guard down, is incredibly important.

dialogue.content: たしかに、そうですねただいまってリラックスできる空間を用意しておいてあげたいですね
dialogue.English: That's true. I'd like to have a space ready where he can say 'I'm home' and relax.

dialogue.content: はい、頑張っている息子さんと一緒に頑張るつもりで、そういう風に安心できる場所であってあげてほしいと思います。
dialogue.English: Yes, I think you can support your hardworking son by providing that kind of safe haven for him.

dialogue.content: はい、そうしてみます
dialogue.English: Yes, I will try that.

dialogue.content: ですので、そんな風に頑張っているあなたも、息子さんと一緒に進んでいくためにも自分の時間を作ってゆっくりもされてみてくださいね。
dialogue.English: So, as you support him in this way, please also make sure to take time for yourself and relax, so you can move forward together with your son.

dialogue.content: 今日はお話したいことは話せた感じでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Do you feel you were able to talk about everything you wanted to today?

dialogue.content: はいありがとうございました
dialogue.English: Yes, thank you very much.

dialogue.content: こちらこそ大切なお話聴かせていただきありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: Thank you for sharing your important story with me.

dialogue.content: それでは本日の相談は終了させていただきますね。失礼いたします。
dialogue.English: Then, we will conclude today's session. Goodbye.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございました
dialogue.English: Thank you very much.

dialogue.content: ロープレの方も終了で大丈夫でしょうか？
dialogue.English: Is it all right to end the role-play here as well?

dialogue.content: はい大丈夫ですお疲れ様でした！ありがとうございました
dialogue.English: Yes, that's fine. Thank you for your hard work! Thank you very much.

dialogue.content: こちらこそありがとうございました。お疲れさまでした。失礼します。
dialogue.English: Thank you as well. Good work today. Take care.
